question: Lanthanides are a series of how many elements?
solution:
The correct answer is __**15.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Lathanides:**

 
• The **first element** in the series, **Lanthanum**, led to the use of the word "lanthanides."
 
• There will be **15 lanthanides** if **chemistry-based similarities** are the main focus.
 
• They were first **discovered **in Sweden's Ytterby **in 1787**.</li
